Please open a Discussion to make the case for allowing general renderables as a `Table` title; new features need approval there before an issue. The [tables guide](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/tables.rst) describes `Table.grid` as a layout tool for arranging renderables, which may help meanwhile. A related request is #4171, which was closed as not planned.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
